selection: Only 5y candidates eligible; >=1% equal-fold validation MAE gain vs best of old selected model, zero, mean, both matched 1y controls. No test selection.
pooling: One model per horizon/candidate shared across 8 indices; one-hot index IDs and past-only cross-index features. Purge by label_end_date across all indices.
test_status: Previously observed dates; exploratory comparison, NOT fresh untouched holdout.
training_span: Expanding all available eligible training origins. Each 5y input has 1261 complete observed sessions; 1y controls use identical origin dates, labels and training rows but only the original80 features.
year_convention: 252 observed exchange sessions per approximate year;1260 sessions is approximately five calendar years, not exact calendar-year subtraction.
cycle_hypothesis: 3-5 year bull/bear timing is a hypothesis, not an assumed periodic label or guaranteed market rule.
